chapter.heading: Hebrews 4
chapter.v: to have failed to reach it.
they were not united by faith with those who listened.
although his works were finished from the foundation of the world.
“And God rested on the seventh day from all his works.”
failed to enter because of disobedience,
For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken of another day later on.
So then, there remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God,
rested from his works as God did from his.
that no one may fall by the same sort of disobedience.
discerning the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
naked and exposed to the eyes of him to whom we must give account.
let us hold fast our confession.
Let us then with confidence draw near to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and find grace to help in time of need.

footnotes.footnote: 4:2 Some manuscripts *it did not meet with faith in the hearers*
